item.title: Probability & Statistics
item.description: Recall, Precision & F1 score Recall (R) R = TP/(TP + FN) i.e. number of true values “recalled” out of total true values Precision (P) P = TP/(TP + FP) i.e. How precise you were in identifying positive cases. Covid RTPCR Test has high precision and low recall. This means if the test result is Covid positive, there is a high chance that it is correct but if it says negative, nothing can said with certainty.
